column1: COSYevents Session Vocabulary Batch — Intake Template
Vocabulary surfaced during interactive COSYevents sessions, webinars, and live community practice.
Note: COSYevents is currently an empty repo as of this writing. This folder is structured as a ready-to-fill template awaiting vocabulary exports from COSYevents sessions.
• Populate language-specific CSVs (english.csv, french.csv, german.csv, spanish.csv) or master all_languages.csv when COSYevents session exports are generated.
• Ensure Session_ID, Category, English, Word, CEFR_Level, and Part_Of_Speech columns are properly filled out.
• Refer to PLAN.md in this folder for full schema alignment rules and intake ingestion pipeline details.
